title: Small Business Entrepreneurship Level II
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: CERTIFICATE OF ACHIEVEMENT SMALL BUSINESS ENTREPRENEURSHIP LEVEL II
outcomes: Apply supervisory and leadership principles to effectively manage employees and business operations in a small business setting.
Prepare and interpret basic accounting records and financial statements to support sound business decision-making.
Use spreadsheet software to analyze, organize, and present business and financial data for small business applications.
Demonstrate professional selling techniques to build customer relationships and increase sales in entrepreneurial ventures.
Evaluate e-commerce opportunities and challenges to integrate online platforms into small business strategies.

missing_explained.why: Named only in the preceding Small Business Entrepreneurship Level I section (BUS 022), not in the Level II required courses, though the Level II description mentions e-commerce.

notes: The award is labeled a Certificate of Achievement requiring 16 to fewer than 30 units, but the catalog prints TOTAL UNITS 14 for this certificate; reviewer should check.
The Level II description says students will examine electronic commerce and the PLOs include e-commerce, yet BUS 022 appears only in the Level I list; the state file lists BUS 22 for this program.
The text page begins mid-way through the Level I section (its outcomes and 21-unit course list), which was not recorded.
Careers taken from 'entry-level positions in sales, supervision, or business operations'; 'aspiring entrepreneurs, small business owners' read as the intended audience, not careers.
